topic: iBioscope network update testing and release
summary_markdown: The team discussed the implementation of 'Provantage: Amend iBioscope to iBioskop Network'. A testing session was scheduled for that evening (around 17:00). The changes were confirmed to be implemented across both beta and production environments. Potential failure points identified included network search functionality on dashboards and within reports related to networks.
decisions: The 'Provantage: Amend iBioscope to iBioskop Network' update was scheduled for release/testing that evening (around 17:00).
